# kion_permission_scheme (Resource)

Manages a Kion Permission Scheme.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_permission_scheme" "example" {
  # Required
  name = "example"
  type = "example"

  # Optional
  # roles = [{
  #   permission_id = 1
  #   role_id       = 1
  # }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the permission scheme in the application.
- `type` (String) Specifies the type of policy. Options are: global, ou, project, or funding_source.

### Optional

- `roles` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of scheme.

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Required:

- `permission_id` (Number) ID of the permission within the application that will be assigned to the role.
- `role_id` (Number) ID of the role within the application that will have the specified permission.
